A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Moner research and contain complete, readable main text and appendices A.1–A.4. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable matching of equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original reconstruction and motion-estimation experiments, ablations, and simulated and real-world 3D MRI results in Section 4 and Appendix A.1.

after.justification: v3 retains these original quantitative experiments and qualitative results, including the real-world 3D MRI study in Appendix A.1.

M1.justification: The INR model, quasi-static motion estimation, projection-domain objective and coarse-to-fine hash encoding are unchanged. The 3D extension in Appendix A.1 already appears in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same fastMRI and MoDL brain data, simulated 3D MRI, and two real-world 3D scans from one subject. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Reconstruction comparisons retain NuIFFT, TV, DRN-DCMB and Score-MoCo; motion-estimation comparisons retain TV and Score-MoCo. Appendix A.1 retains NuIFFT as the 3D comparator.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A.1–A.3 retain the same data splits, sampling and motion settings, optimization budgets, registration procedures, metrics and scanner acquisition parameters.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same motion-model, forward-model and hash-encoding ablations. Out-of-domain comparisons, motion-trajectory analyses and supplementary visual examples are also unchanged.

E5.justification: The existing mean/standard-deviation summaries and t-test significance reporting are unchanged. v3 adds no seed information, repeated-run counts or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and the qualitative results retain their entries and findings. For example, Table 2 retains Moner's fastMRI PSNR of 32.62±2.61 at AF=2× and MR=±5; Table 6 retains 31.58 PSNR and 0.844 SSIM for the corresponding 3D condition.

T1.justification: The Fourier-slice derivation, motion assumptions, spatial transformations, optimization formulations and motion-error definitions in Equations 1–14 are unchanged. No formal result or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same methodological contributions and claims about unsupervised reconstruction, comparable in-domain performance, out-of-domain advantages and efficiency.

C2.justification: The limitations paragraph gains a separate 'Limitation' label but preserves its qualifications about dimensionality, intra-frame and nonrigid motion, spin-history effects and sampling patterns. Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged.

D1.justification: The v3 abstract adds a Moner code-repository address absent from v2. Existing implementation, hyperparameter, hardware and acquisition details remain unchanged. The PDFs establish additional access information, not the repository's completeness or usability.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference-list content and positioning relative to prior MRI reconstruction and motion-correction methods are unchanged. References merely flow across different page boundaries.

P1.justification: v3 updates the publication header and author email addresses, adds the code sentence and acknowledgements, and changes 'Conclusion and Limitation' to 'Conclusion' with a separately labeled limitations paragraph. The remaining narrative is unchanged.

P2.justification: All 18 figures and seven tables retain their content. Front-page reflow, revised headers and acknowledgements cause modest spacing, placement and page-break changes, including around Figure 8, Table 6 and the references.

improvement.justification: The new code link supplies implementation access information missing from v2, while acknowledgements add funding and assistance attribution. These modest documentation benefits support a limited improvement; methods, evidence and limitations remain unchanged, and code usability cannot be assessed from the PDFs.
